name: @meonode/compiler
description: SWC WASM plugin that rewrites @meonode/ui call sites into pre-partitioned marker props at build time, letting the @meonode/ui runtime skip its own static/dynamic prop classification and prop-signature hashing on every render

scripts.build: cargo build --release -p meonode-swc-plugin --target wasm32-wasip1 && cp ../target/wasm32-wasip1/release/meonode_swc_plugin.wasm . && cp ../README.md .
scripts.build:debug: cargo build -p meonode-swc-plugin --target wasm32-wasip1 && cp ../target/wasm32-wasip1/debug/meonode_swc_plugin.wasm . && cp ../README.md .
